operation: Existing Show editor on the v2 backing at 1440x900 with reduced motion; fresh Installation Shows seeded through /api/shows and stored as v2. Re-captured at the hardened tip. Capture 1: two Clips on one Layer, no Transition (TestPattern1D 0-30 s, CometLoom 30-60 s on layer:zone-1:main). CometLoom is selected first, opening its Entity Detail Panel (Details), then dropped a quarter of the way in, over TestPattern1D. The clip-temporal owner refuses the overlap: CometLoom shows the red 'Space taken' label and the timeline role=status reads 'Clips on one Layer cannot overlap.'. Details are untouched by the refused drop: CometLoom stays selected (aria-pressed true, TestPattern1D false), the panel still shows CometLoom at the same box (x 437.19, y 152.38, 408x488 before and after), and the Details re-anchor lookup (document.querySelectorAll('[data-show-selection-key]'), counted from just before the drag) ran 0 times. 1.5 s later the stored v2 record is unchanged (updatedAt 1790224417867 before and after; both Clips' id, start, duration and Layer identical). Capture 2 (Show 4e0c49e0-20a6-46ed-9b19-459134a83bff): the default Installation Show with its converted crossfade Transition (30000-31999 ms), plus a second empty Layer added through Add > Layer because the Transition's own control covers its Layer. A double-click on that Layer at 31000 ms refuses the add: the timeline role=status reads 'A Clip cannot start inside a Transition.', no Clip label, no add dialog, stored updatedAt unchanged. The status line is screen-reader only; the proof script removed its sr-only class for the capture alone and drew it bottom-left. Capture 3 (Show 79cc9bad-5323-4e53-8f6f-4cb40bb750cb): the same two-Clip Show. An Alt-drag of CometLoom starts; mid-drag the page's store adopts a record whose Show End is extended to 90 s at a new revision (standing in for another tab or the agent). The timeline redraws against 90 s, so the copy at the lane's end clamps past the drag's captured 60 s Show End; the duplicate check refuses the preview (none painted) and the drag ends with no drop. The release reports it as a race: CometLoom shows 'Show changed', the status reads 'The Show changed; try again.', no 'Space taken' appears, and the stored record is unchanged (updatedAt 1790224417866 before and after). A plain Alt-duplicate cannot reach this refusal: both drag paths clamp the copy inside the current Show End.
